units.source_text: 一般人家的屋顶都葺上细木板，铺上石子。

en.t: The roofs of ordinary houses were shingled with thin wooden boards and covered with stones.

units.source_text: 那些圆圆的石子，只有阳光照到的一面，在雪中露出黑糊糊的表层。

en.t: Those round stones showed their dark, blackened surfaces in the snow only on the side touched by sunlight.

units.source_text: 那不是潮湿的颜色，而是久经风雪剥蚀，像墨一般黑。

en.t: It was not the color of dampness, but a black like ink, worn down by long years of wind and snow.

units.source_text: 一排排低矮的房子静静地伏卧在大地上，给人这样的感觉：家家户户好像那些石子一样。真是一派北国的风光。

en.t: Rows of low houses lay quietly crouched against the earth, giving the feeling that every household was like those stones. It was truly a northern-country scene.
